name: DGI housing law — weekly comprehensive legal verification

schedule.description: Monday legal audit; GitHub Actions performs evidence collection, separate scheduled reviewer verifies substance

inventory.latest_editorial_content: Published CMS content and production sitemap must also be checked; do not assume migrated JSON is the live source of truth

first_priority.purpose: official publication and consolidated current texts of federal and regional legislation
official publication of enacted normative acts
Moscow government services, regulations and DGI
Moscow Oblast official legal and housing information
Supreme Court published acts and explanations
real estate registry rules and services

authority_rules: Never treat a draft bill, proposal or press release as law in force
Verify effective date and later amendments, including transitional provisions
For municipal regulations verify current numbered version and responsible agency
If official site denies automatic access (403/429/timeout), mark verification incomplete; do not infer repeal
Use secondary systems for discovery and corroboration, never to override authoritative current official acts
Do not infer case outcome from cassation denial alone; inspect operative part and prior lower-court decisions

review_scope: statutory references, act numbers, article and paragraph references
effective dates, amendments, repeals, pending implementation and transition rules
filing and court deadlines, limitation periods, competent court and agency
state-service application channels, required attachments, fees, duties and eligibility
DGI housing register, privatization, social tenancies, renovation, eviction, expropriation, land and city property
Moscow and Moscow Oblast geographic applicability and jurisdiction
EGRN, cadastral valuation, inheritance, subsidies, housing payments, homeowners and apartment buildings
legal consequences, exceptions, vulnerable groups and procedural safeguards
claimant-favorable judicial practice summaries and PDF/source fidelity
all hyperlinks to normative acts, legal procedures and services
publication and SEO metadata, clarity, accessible headings and absence of empty sections

scope: Moscow and Moscow Oblast property rules
government services and current application requirements

evidence_required_for_each_material_chan: original numbered act or official service
